GitHub - responsively-org/responsively-app: A modified web browser that helps in responsive web development. A web developer's must have dev-tool. · GitHub

name: Responsively App
summary: Open-source browser that previews a site on many devices side by side and mirrors your interactions.
description: An Electron-based browser for responsive development: it renders the same page across many device previews side by side, mirrors clicks, scrolling and navigation across all of them, and adds a unified elements inspector, one-click screenshots, 30+ built-in device profiles and savable preview layouts. Ships a built-in MCP server so AI coding agents can drive it; free and open source.
contains: Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux (Electron)
Mirrors clicks, scrolling and navigation across all device previews in real time
30+ built-in device profiles with custom devices and saved Preview Suites
Unified elements inspector across all devices
One-click full-page screenshots of all devices at once
Browser extension for Chrome, Firefox and Edge
Built-in MCP server for AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor
Free and open source under AGPL-3.0; 150k+ downloads
